spans.s:
स्निग्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, oily, oleaginous, unctuous,
greasy, fat, sticky, viscid, cohesive, adhesive; emol-
lient, smooth; glossy, shining, resplendent; moist,
wet; cooling; bland, kind, amiable; attached, lov-
ing, tender, affectionate, friendly, well affected; lovely,
agreeable; coarse, thick, dense; (अस्), m. a friend;
a sort of pine, (see स्निग्ध-दारु below); the red
castor-oil plant; scil. गण्डूष, a particular mode
of rinsing the mouth; (आ), f. marrow, = मेदा;
(अम्), n. oil; bees'-wax; light, lustre; thickness,
coarseness.
—स्निग्ध-जन, अस्, m. an affectionate
or friendly person, a friend.
—स्निग्ध-तण्डुल, अस्,
m. a kind of rice of quick growth (= षष्टिक).
—स्निग्ध-ता, f. or स्निग्ध-त्व, अम्, n. unctuous-
ness, oiliness; blandness; tenderness, kindness, affec-
tion, love.
—स्निग्ध-दारु, उ, n. a sort of pine,
Pinus Longifolia (= सरल); another kind, Pinus
Devadaru.
—स्निग्ध-पत्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having
smooth or glossy leaves; (अस्, आ), m. f. the jujube,
Zizyphus Jujuba; (आ), f. a kind of plant (= काश्-
मरी); another kind (= पालक्या).
—स्निग्ध-
पत्त्रक, अस्, m. ‘having smooth leaves,’ a kind of
grass; other plants (= घृत-करञ्ज; = गुच्छ-
करञ्ज).
—स्निग्ध-पिण्डीतक, अस्, m. a kind of
Madana tree.
—स्निग्ध-फल, अस्, आ, अम्, having
unctuous fruit, having glossy fruit; (आ), f. the ich-
neumon plant (= नाकुली).
—स्निग्ध-वर्ण, अस्,
आ, अम्, having a glossy or bright colour; having a
soft or agreeable complexion.

स्निट् स्निट्, cl. 10. P. स्नेटयति, to go; to
love, be in love; [cf. rt. 1. स्निह् below.]

स्निह् 1. स्निह्, cl. 4. P. स्निह्यति, सिष्णेह,
स्नेहिष्यति or स्नेक्ष्यति, अस्निहत्,
स्नेहितुम् or स्नेग्धुम् or स्नेढुम्, (probably
originally) to be adhesive or sticky or viscid; to be
bland; to be easily attached; to have affection for,
love, regard; to be fond of (with gen.); to be kind
to or pleased with; cl. 10. P. स्नेहयति, &c., to be
unctuous or greasy: Pass. स्निह्यते, Aor. अस्नेहि:
Caus. स्नेहयति, &c., Aor. असिष्णिहत्, to make
unctuous, anoint, lubricate; to cause to love, &c.; to
dissolve, destroy, kill, slay, (in Naigh.

. स्नेह-
यति and [according to some readings] स्नेहति are
enumerated amongst the वध-कर्माणः): Desid.
सिस्नेहिषति, सिस्निहिषति, सिस्निक्षति: Intens.
सेष्णिह्यते, सेष्णेग्धि or सेष्णेढि.

2. स्निह्, ट्, ट्, ट्, or क्, क्, क्, loving, affectionate; one
who loves.

स्निग्ध्वा or स्निहित्वा, ind. becoming unctuous,
becoming bland or affectionate.
स्नीढ, अस्, आ, अम्, attached, bland, tender, loving.
स्नीहिति, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. killing, slaying.

स्नीहिती, f., Ved. killing, slaying; malevolent, (Sāy.
= वध-कारिणी, Ṛg-veda
